title: Bundle SQLite for remote workbench storage
reason: The server-backed browser storage patch imports @vscode/sqlite3, but the reh-web distribution only packages production dependencies declared by remote/package.json. Pinning the existing upstream SQLite version in the remote dependency set keeps global and workspace state databases available in packaged Cantrip Code.
validation: Open a packaged Code tab and confirm the remote agent log contains no @vscode/sqlite3 module resolution errors
removal: Remove if the server-backed storage patch is removed or upstream reh-web begins packaging @vscode/sqlite3 itself.
